content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Ann Arbor

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's credential handbook to verify you meet the prerequisites. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can clarify eligibility questions and help you document your qualifications before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. All sessions are delivered online, allowing you to learn from your Ann Arbor location on a schedule that fits your career. You'll study frameworks, tools, and real-world scenarios with active certified practitioners.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training, submit your formal application directly to PMI and pay the examination fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process. PMI reviews your credentials to confirm eligibility before you're cleared to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. When you're ready, schedule your PMP exam through PMI's testing partner. You'll test at a local proctored center or online, depending on your preference.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or project-management activities. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you meet renewal requirements and stay current in the field.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
